title: Destination C1&C2 · Unit 14 · G · Phrasal verbs with 'together' · tr.116

parts.name: G · Phrasal verbs with 'together' · tr.116
parts.instructions: Phrasal verbs with 'together', such as 'club together', often contain the idea of people doing something as a group. Does the sentence contain that idea?

items.stem: Eight countries in the region have banded together to make a free-trade zone.

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Banded together là nhiều nước cùng lập thành nhóm.

items.stem: I didn't know anyone was coming to dinner, so I had to cobble a meal together from whatever was in the fridge.

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Cobble together là chắp vá vội, không phải cả nhóm cùng làm.

items.stem: Why don't we all get together on Tuesday evening?

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Get together là cả nhóm gặp nhau.

items.stem: The twins have been behaving so badly recently. I should knock their heads together!

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Knock heads together là cách nói hình ảnh, không phải cùng nhau làm việc.

items.stem: Everyone in the village pulled together to make the carnival a success.

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Pull together là cùng chung sức.

items.stem: The only way we'll all get off this mountain alive is if we stick together.

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Stick together là ở cạnh nhau, cùng nhau.

items.stem: The three of us put together quite an interesting proposal.

options.text: Yes – people doing something as a group

items.explanation_vi: Đáp án sách là No: put together ở đây chỉ là ghép thành một đề xuất.
items.review_reason: Câu này có thể hiểu là ba người cùng làm, nhưng đáp án sách là No.
